_comment: Vendored snapshots of the three layer wrappers' .github/workflows/swift-ci.yml, byte-for-byte as fetched from each repository's default branch at the commit below. Task 1-01 (swift-institute/.github#276, #281) characterizes the wrapper/universal relationship, which requires reading all three wrappers at exact heads (programme precondition) even though this repository's own CI cannot check out sibling repositories. These are point-in-time evidence, not a live sync: test-verdict-inventory.py builds the committed verdict-inventory.json from these bytes plus this repository's own live swift-ci.yml, and a drift test catches the LOCAL file changing out from under the committed inventory. A wrapper edit in its own repository does not retrigger this repository's CI; re-vending these three files (and re-running the builder) is a manual step the next lane touching this area must perform, exactly like re-deriving any other moving head in the programme.
